fields.name: Room Shining
fields.description: Room Shining is a professional cleaning company based in Minsk, providing top-quality cleaning services for residential and commercial properties. We specialize in apartment and house cleaning, window washing, dry cleaning of furniture and carpets, post-renovation cleaning, and disinfection. Our team of trained specialists uses modern eco-friendly products and professional equipment to make every room shine. Over 5,000 completed orders and hundreds of satisfied clients trust us with their cleanliness.
fields.history:
2018 — Company founded, first 3 employees
2019 — Expanded to window washing and dry cleaning
2020 — Second office opened, 15 specialists
2021 — Post-renovation cleaning launched
2022 — Switched to eco-friendly products
2023 — 5,000 completed orders
2024 — Disinfection services added
2025 — 30+ employees, citywide coverage

fields.description: Professional window cleaning specialist with 3 years of experience. Expert in cleaning windows of any size and height, including balcony blocks, showcases, and large panoramic windows. Works with professional tools and eco-friendly solutions. Guarantees streak-free shine and spotless results. Detail-oriented, punctual, and trusted by over 300 clients.

fields.name: Cleaning of a 1-room apartment
fields.description: Complete cleaning of a 1-room apartment: dust removal, wet cleaning, bathroom and toilet. All products included. Time: 2-3 hours.

fields.name: Cleaning of a 2-room apartment
fields.description: Complete cleaning of a 2-room apartment: dust removal, wet cleaning, bathroom and toilet, mirror polishing, garbage removal. All products included. Time: 3–4 hours.

fields.name: Eco-Friendly Apartment Cleaning
fields.description: Complete cleaning using only eco-friendly, non-toxic products safe for children and pets.

fields.name: Green Office Sanitization
fields.description: Sanitization of office spaces with eco-friendly disinfectants, leaving no harmful residues.

fields.title: We Have Updated Our Cleaning Products
fields.short_description: We now use eco-friendly and hypoallergenic cleaning products that are safe for children and pets.
fields.content: Our company has switched to a new line of eco-friendly cleaning products from a leading European manufacturer. All products are biodegradable, fragrance-free, and safe for families with small children and pets. This upgrade allows us to provide even higher quality cleaning services without harming the environment. Book a cleaning and experience the difference!

fields.title: 15% Discount on Post-Renovation Cleaning
fields.short_description: Get a 15% discount on post-renovation cleaning until the end of the month.
fields.content: Finished your renovation? We will help you get rid of construction dust and debris quickly and professionally. Until the end of the month, all post-renovation cleaning services are available with a 15% discount. Use promo code RENOV15 when booking online or mention it when calling. Offer valid for apartments and cottages.

fields.title: We Now Work on Weekends
fields.short_description: We have expanded our schedule — now you can book cleaning on Saturdays and Sundays.
fields.content: We know that weekdays are often busy, and finding time for cleaning can be difficult. Starting this month, our teams work seven days a week, including weekends. You can now schedule cleaning at a convenient time on Saturday or Sunday. Book online or call us to choose your preferred date.

fields.question: What cleaning products do you use?
fields.answer: We use professional eco-friendly and hypoallergenic cleaning products that are safe for children and pets. All products are certified and biodegradable.

fields.question: Do I need to be present during the cleaning?
fields.answer: It is not necessary. Many clients entrust us with keys. All our employees are verified, trained, and the company bears full responsibility for the safety of your property.

fields.name: Cleaner
fields.description: We are looking for a responsible cleaner to join our team. Duties include wet and dry cleaning of apartments and offices, dust removal, floor washing, bathroom and toilet cleaning. Work schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00. We provide all cleaning products and equipment. No experience required — we will train you. Competitive salary, friendly team, official employment.

fields.name: Window Cleaning Specialist
fields.description: We need a window cleaning specialist for residential and commercial properties. Duties include window and balcony block washing, frame cleaning, glass polishing. Work at various locations around the city. Schedule: flexible, part-time or full-time. Equipment and cleaning products provided. Experience preferred but not mandatory. Salary based on completed orders.

fields.text: Ordered apartment cleaning. The team arrived on time, everything was done perfectly. The apartment literally shines! Special thanks for the eco-friendly products — no chemical smell at all. Will definitely order again.
